enchantments.tooltip: Sea Attunement: While you are a Water Elemental, you gain bonuses to the caster level, spell power, and crit chance for your Cold spells.
Glaciation +94: Passive: +94 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Ice Lore +14: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Magical Efficiency 5%: You take a 5% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.

Hruit's Influence: While wearing three items from the Hruit's Influence set, you gain:+25 Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Positive Spell Power+5% Artifact bonus to Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Positive Spell Crit Chance+2 Artifact bonus to Wisdom+1 Artifact bonus to Spell DCs
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
